selection_method: Eligible base tasks (prompt and original tests parse with ast) sampled with random.Random(260904170).sample(sorted ids, 100). Difficulty proxy: prompt docstring length in characters (ties by numeric id). Sorted by the proxy and cut into strata of 3; each full stratum gets the first seeded-random permutation of (original, oneoff, conflicting) whose mutated tests conform (oneoff: exactly one assert differs; conflicting: a repeated input with a different expectation); the leftover task is oneoff. Each base task appears once, in one variant.
